notes.title: Build 0.2.1
notes.content:
[h1][b]Build 0.2.1 release[/b][/h1]

[h2][u][b]Create a fresh save file, or you'll experience bugs![/b][/u][/h2]

🦈[b]Shuro[/b] here. In the previous update some of you encountered a bug with a very small cursor. To fix, please go to settings in game menu and reset them. It was caused by save system, and I'm still figuring out how to edit Player's saves on other PCs.

Also, turns out most of sprites in game had [b]compression[/b] enabled, which caused them to look weird. I went over all sprites in the game and disabled it, since it doesn't work with pixel art. But because of that, the game now requires 35% more disk space. Now a lot of sprites in game look better. I will later see what can I do to lower the required disk space. Okay, too much yapping, time for updates.

[h3][b]Additions and Fixes:[/b][/h3]

[list]
[*] Added elemental damage and skill cooldown upgrades to Shrine Upgrades and Skull Upgrades.
[*] Added a Completed Runs menu in the Hub. Interact with it to view the last 20 completed runs. Failed runs will be included there too.
[*] Added opacity setting to Player's skills in options menu. If they are causing too much distraction, you can tweak their visibility.
[*] Added brightness and contrast setting to options menu. Also added a reset button to return all option sliders to default values.
[*] Added auto shoot toggle in options menu. If enabled, Player will shoot at the nearest enemy. Enable this if you don;t want to click a lot, or just playing around skills. Although, this option will target nearest enemies EVEN when the Mini Boss is alive. So be careful with it.
[*] Played a lot with material and shader amount in the game. Now the game will run a bit better. Another addition to optimization.
[*] Golden Skull now has a proper spawn animation. You can't miss it in game now.
[*] Golden Skulls now will have a max spawn amount for each difficulty, so that the player wouldn't spam difficulty 0 to farm them.
[*] FIXED: Options menu values weren't saving correctly.
[/list]

notes.title: Build 0.2.0
notes.content:
[h1][b]Build 0.2.0 release[/b][/h1]

[h2][u][b]Create a fresh save file, or you'll experience bugs![/b][/u][/h2]

🦈[b]Shuro[/b] here. Previous update was released quite a while ago, so first of all I will say that future updates will come out faster. I went over different mechanics and ideas to add, but a lot of them didn't really work with the current direction of the game. Anyway, I will point out main features of the update, and then list all additional stuff.

[h3][b]Skill Cards:[/b][/h3]
Brought back skill cards with a lot of rework and additions to them. Now there are 6 different elements: Fire, Ice, Lightning, Necromancy, Death and Blood. Each element has unique effects, active states to apply on the enemies and 4 active skills. In total: [b]48[/b] new skill cards and [b]24[/b] active skills. These cards will be in the default pool of cards, but Player needs to grab the first card of the element to unlock the whole tree. Besides increasing skill damage, elemental cards will also increase Weapon's stats. In Short: [b]Fire[/b] - Attack Speed / Bullet Speed, [b]Ice[/b] - Critical Chance / Critical Damage, [b]Lightning[/b] - Projectiles / Bounce, [b]Necromancy[/b] - Damage Resist / Dodge, [b]Death[/b] - Bullet Damage / Bullet Size, [b]Blood[/b] - Max Health / Health Regeneration. These cards can be viewed in game when you collect them, and they work the same as Weapon cards with rewards on collecting 3, 6, and 9 cards in each element. New Active Skills are obtainable from these rewards.

[h3][b]Merge Cards:[/b][/h3]
In addition to Skill cards, I added [b]18[/b] [b]Merge[/b] cards. These are cards that will add unique properties, additions and behavior to the Bullet. They range from making the bullet apply elemental states, to changes of it's fly pattern. To get Merge cards, Player first needs to meet it's requirements. There are 6 types of Merge cards, just like the amount of elements, and each type has 3 tiers. So to obtain for example first Merge card of Fire, Player needs to have Tag "Attack Speed" on level 3, and Tag "Fire" on level 3 (Tier 1 - 3/3, Tier 2 - 6/6, Tier 3 - 9/9). After meeting the requirements, they will be added to the pool of cards.

[h3][b]Enemy Visuals:[/b][/h3]
I managed to find a talented pixel artist for my game. For now, only the default enemies have been reworked with new sprites, excluding the stone golem and cavalry knight. Expect more changes to all visuals, including UI.

[h3][b]Settings:[/b][/h3]
Added a simple settings window with a selection of resolution, cursor scale, crosshair variants and volume sliders. I already started to make new settings options, such us the ability to change the opacity of elements in game and custom color filters.

That's it for the big changes. I believe if I will polish the balance of new skill cards and add an upgrade options for them, the combat mechanics will be finished for the most part. Please contact me if you have some ideas or want to point out any bugs. Now for additional changes.

[h3][b]Additions and Fixes:[/b][/h3]

[list]
[*] Adjusted the temp at which the run gets harder: max enemy count, spawn rate, health growth and more. Now the growth is smoother.
[*] Added 2 new enemies that will replace 2 default enemies later in the game. They're basically stronger and faster. Added that so Player constantly gets new enemies.
[*] Changed Explosive enemies damage amount and spawn rate. Now they deal less damage to enemies and Player. Sometimes they were dealing too much and one-shoting Player with 160 hp.
[*] Adjusted enemy health and damage scaling.
[*] Added color mix to the Player's bullet, depending the active Merge cards.
[*] Visuals for Player's teleportation and Utility Shield have been changed.
[*] Now if Player interacts with animals in the hub, they will spawn hearts. Idk, I was bored one evening and added this.
[*] Added a small animation to buttons in Main Menu. Planning to rework the whole menu soon.
[*] Added some prompts to different menus.
[*] Replaced the cursor in the game. Now it will change depending on the area it's pointing at.
[*] All new skills and state are added to the Death Screen damage chart, and it will show all sources at the same time.
[*] Death Screen damage chart now counts DPS for each source depending on the time it was obtained, instead of the total time spent in the run. Just for more precise numbers.
[*] Started working on big performance fixes. There's a lot to optimize, but hopefully the game runs smoother now. (Also bumped into some bottlenecks with Unity Engine, and that's not good)
[*] FIXED: Push circle on level up wasn't pushing enemies when they were attacking at the same time.
[*] FIXED: UI had scaling problems with lower resolutions.
[*] FIXED: Some effects, that were supposed to activate on enemy death, weren't working properly.
[*] FIXED: Fixed my sanity with Death Stranding 2 after playing Dark Souls 2 (This souls is not great...)
[*] FIXED: Enemies had incorrect timing with their attacks. Now melee enemies are a bit more dangerous because it's fixed.
[*] FIXED: some effects were causing problems, when there are no enemies on the map.
[*] FIXED: Loading the save file, if the Player was currently in the middle of the run, was causing bugs.
[*] FIXED: Sometimes the second Mini Boss wasn't spawning at all.
[*] FIXED: The wall, created by first Mini Boss and stone golem later in the game was causing the Player to become stuck.
[*] FIXED: Enemy projectiles were launching with different speed from the same type of enemies.
[/list]

notes.title: Build 0.1.18
notes.content:
[h1][b]Build 0.1.18 release[/b][/h1]

[h2][u][b]Create a fresh save file, or you'll experience bugs![/b][/u][/h2]
[h2][u][b]Skill Cards are currently disabled for balancing purposes.[/b][/u][/h2]

[i][b]Shuro[/b] here. There's a lot to unpack in this update. This update brings new upgrade mechanics and a lot of additional changes. First I will write about big main additions, but the rest of small changes/fixes will be listed at the bottom.
Okay, so what's new:[/i]

[h3][b]Shrine Upgrades:[/b][/h3]
Souls, that you obtain during the game, now can be spent in the "Shrine". It's located in the top left corner of the Hub. Shrine will give [b]global upgrades[/b] to a collection of stats. After upgrading one stat, it's cost of upgrade increases. Each stat has it's own price and upgrade cap.

[h3][b]Skull Sacrifice:[/b][/h3]
Now the Player can collect [b]Golden Skulls[/b] during the game. Their drop rate is low, but can be increased by playing higher difficulties (Difficulties explained below). By interacting a giant skeleton hand with a purple flame in the Hub, Player will open a menu with upgrades. Each upgrade costs 1 Golden skull and boosts the Player's stats. Comparing to the Shrine upgrades, Skull Sacrifice has a very high stat cap. Additionally, Golden Skulls can be purchased in Soul Shop for a big price.

[h3][b]Difficulty Cauldron:[/b][/h3]
Intractable object, just like the shrine. It opens up a menu where the Player can select current difficulty of the session. Each difficulty increases Enemy's strength, but also boosts the rewards from playing on this difficulty. After defeating specific bosses on difficulties, that the Player didn't complete, will reward him with [b]Weapon Upgrade Tokens[/b] (Weapon Upgrades is listed below). Rewards for the difficulty are unique for every weapon. If the Player manages to complete higher difficulties, he will receive rewards for [b]all[/b] previous difficulties that he didn't complete with the current weapon.

[h3][b]Weapon Upgrades:[/b][/h3]
Player now receives Weapon Upgrade tokens from completing difficulties with each weapon. These tokens can be spent in Weapon Upgrade menu. To access it, grab the weapon, and interact with the same weapon on the wall that you're currently holding. Each weapon has a limited amount of levels, and the cost for these levels is growing with each upgrade. This system allows Player to upgrade the [b]Base Stats[/b] of the weapon, that will be later scaled with other buffs.

[h3][b]Cheat Sins:[/b][/h3]
Now there's a Cheat Sins altar next to the right wall in the Hub. Player can give himself souls, golden skulls and weapon upgrade tokens. I added this because I am constantly reworking the Save System code, and this could lead to you losing a bunch of progress. Also it's a nice tool to test the game, and I will remove it later. It's protected by a password, good luck finding it :)

[i]Alright, these are the big changes. Now here's the rest of additions and fixes:[/i]

[h3][b]Additions and Fixes:[/b][/h3]

[list]
[*] Re-balanced base stats for all weapons.
[*] Small balance adjustments to Level Up Cards.
[*] T1_Ammo_2 card effect now activates on shooting the last bullet in the magazine.
[*] Knight attack is faster now.
[*] Champion chest now explodes with soul fountain on pickup.
[*] Player can now press a close button during the Level Up, if he thinks that he doesn't need any of the given rewards.
[*] Added a DPS meter to the Player in game stats. It resets every second.
[*] Arrow pointer during the game now has a proper position, and shouldn't go off the screen.
[*] Added a version check popup when loading the old save file.
[*] Visual changes to damage numbers: new text style, animations of moving and disappearing, bigger scale to critical hits.
[*] Pause menu now has a hotkey image for turning on the Player Stats UI.
[*] Now if the Player enabled Player Stats UI once, he doesn't need to enable them every run.
[*] Attack Speed values are easier to understand now.
[*] Added a soul image next to the collected souls in game.
[*] Decreased the size of crossbow sprite. It was too big.
[*] Pressing ESC button now will close the current active menu. Works with every interface.
[*] Played a bit with stacking sound problem. It's still not great, but hey, at least that's something.
[*] FIXED: Pickups and items weren't disappearing after triggering the Final Boss fight.
[*] FIXED: Teleport to the Final Boss was spawning inside the Player, trapping him there.[i] I hope that it's fixed.[/i]
[*] FIXED: Picking up the Champion chest and obtaining the level up at the same time was causing the Player to freeze.
[*] FIXED: Golden card functionality is still not in the game, so I disabled a visual for them.
[*] FIXED: Sometimes Magnet pickup effect wasn't stopping. It was fun to play with it, but it's a bug :)
[*] FIXED: Death Screen was showing old unused tag.
[/list]

[*] Pickups now should properly spawn inside Mini Boss arena if Mini Boss is alive.
[*] Fixed a bug with Mini Boss hp bar.
[*] Mage Girl Mini Boss wasn't spawning properly. It should be fixed now.
[*] Removed 50/50 % utility card for now.
[*] Utility card that was taking all of Player's health now takes 90%.
[/list]

notes.title: Build 0.1.5
notes.content:
[h1][i][b]Build 0.1.5 release[/b][/i][/h1]

[h2][u][b]Create a fresh save file, or you'll experience bugs![/b][/u][/h2]

[h2][u][b]Skill Cards and pickups are currently disabled for balancing purposes.[/b][/u][/h2]

[h3][u][b]Additions: [/b][/u][/h3]

[list]
[*] New Card System. Each tag now has 9 cards and 3 rewards for achieving certain level of this tag.
[*] Marker for the direction where the boss is, if boss is not on the screen.
[*] Invincibility after obtaining Level Up. It lasts for 2 seconds after closing the Level Up screen.
[*] Improved scaling of EXP and Enemy Health.
[*] Level Up now shows all available Bullet Merges, but only 1 can be active.
[/list]

[h3][u][b]Fixes:[/b][/u][/h3]

[b]Balance:[/b]

[list]
[*] EXP gain is decreased drastically closer to the end of the run.
[*] Bullet now flies backwards after bouncing off the target.
[*] Bullet bounce now activates AFTER all piercing effects.
[*] Bullet bounce and piercing now have a 30% damage reduction after bounce/piercing the enemy.
[*] All Bosses and Champions received a big Health boost.
[*] Sniper Rifle now has more Piercing and Critical Damage values.
[*] All skills are currently in Rework.
[/list]

[b]Game behavior:[/b]

[list]
[*] Now all Utility and Skill effects doesn't work in safe areas.
[*] Mini Boss arena now spawns properly, if the Player is next to the corner of the map.
[*] Teleport to the Boss arena now should spawn properly next to the Player.
[*] Player Skills now properly disabling and activating after resurrecting.
[*] Perks now properly giving Max Health to Player.
[/list]

[b]UI:[/b]

[list]
[*] 3 Level Up cards are centered now.
[*] Level Up now doesn't activates after Player dies.
[*] Progression tree now shows perks correctly after returning to the hub.
[*] Progression tree now shows arrows between perks, rather than lines.
[*] Character icon now changes after switching to another character.
[*] Entrance to the Game Arena now activates through interaction, rather than collision.
[*] Damage chart in the end of the game now doesn't show empty sources with damage.
[*] Boss Hp now properly shows 100%, when boss spawns.
[*] Boss Hp now flashes a little, when Boss receives damage.
[*] Dialogue now advances after pressing Space bar, or clicking anywhere on the screen.
[*] A lot of small UI improvements.
[*] After pressing "To Hub" in Game Area, the Player dies. It also shows game statistic. 
[/list]

[b]Visuals:[/b]

[list]
[*] Death Aura now is circular. It's easier to see the range of it now.
[*] Removed colliders on some objects on the map. Now The Player can collide only with trees.
[*] Souls are smaller and less distracting now. Their growth rate on merging has been decreased.
[*] All Bosses now have a proper transitions to death animations.
[*] Lamps on the map are less distracting now.
[*] Enemy brightness is increased overall.
[*] Items from the shop should spawn correctly now.
[/list]

notes.title: Build 0.1.4.1
notes.content: Changed EXP gain amount for all enemies. Some additional changes to max level exp.
